channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: New officer takes command of the Red Arrows
item.description: Wing Commander Sasha Nash has taken command of the Royal Air Force Aerobatic Team, becoming the new Officer Commanding of the Red Arrows as the display unit prepares for the 2026 season.

item.title: New tugboats for Faslane will not be built in China
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has now confirmed that vessels procured under the Defence Maritime Services programme, including tugs for Faslane, will not be built in China.

item.title: UK and Poland agree deeper missile defence cooperation
item.description: The UK and Poland have agreed to deepen cooperation on air and missile defence and expand helicopter training links, as both countries look to strengthen their ability to counter airborne threats.

item.title: After Maduro and what the Venezuela move means
item.description: No one with a pulse can really have been surprised at recent events in Venezuela argues Lt Col Stuart Crawford.

item.title: UK sets out Project Grayburn rifle replacement to industry
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has issued an industry notice expanding concept work on Project GRAYBURN, the long-running effort to replace the SA80, with an emphasis on UK manufacture, multiple variants and defeating modern body armour.

item.title: UK confirms entry ranks for Armed Forces Gap Year scheme
item.description: Participants in the new Armed Forces Foundation Year will serve at entry-level ranks across all three Services, with the pilot scheme set to launch in 2026 at a cost of £13 million. The post UK confirms entry ranks for Armed Forces Gap Year scheme first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD admits Project Rarden accounts entry was an error
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that a £3.7 million entry linked to Project Rarden in its latest accounts was incorrectly labelled and does not relate to any active armoured vehicle programme. The post MOD admits Project Rarden accounts entry was an error first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No dates or numbers for RCH 155 artillery
item.description: The Ministry of Defence says it is still too early to confirm delivery timelines or fleet size for the RCH 155 wheeled artillery system, despite ongoing trials of two guns. The post No dates or numbers for RCH 155 artillery first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK-led Ukraine force set out, deployment tied to ceasefire
item.description: Ministers have defined the mission of a UK- and France-led multinational force for Ukraine, confirming it would only deploy after a cessation of hostilities and subject to a parliamentary vote. The post UK-led Ukraine force set out, deployment tied to ceasefire first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rutte urges deeper NATO-EU defence cooperation
item.description: The NATO Secretary General has told MEPs that closer cooperation between NATO and the EU is essential to boost defence production, sustain support for Ukraine and strengthen European security. The post Rutte urges deeper NATO-EU defence cooperation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
